name: Payment Target Preparation Requested
description: Request emitted from a MyOS Balance Account document when its owner asks MyOS Admin to prepare an opaque recipient payment target.

amount.description: Optional expected payment amount in minor units.

expiresAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 expiry timestamp for the prepared target.

documentId.description: Blue document id identifying the business document this payment is for.

expectedPaynote.description: Optional matcher over the PayNote bootstrap input that will be accepted for this target.
